column2: I'll tell you, as a souvenir for your trip to the afterlife.\n\nI am Miroku Mugen, son of Taigen Mugen, lord of Kuryu Castle!
You've got spirit.\n\nI am Miroku Mugen, son of Taigen Mugen, lord of Kuryu Castle!
Maybe they ran off after the Slum King lost to Jack?
The Dragons are on the move! Let's back Jack up!
Actually... I was thinking the same thing.\n\nJust like Great King Enma said, other worlds in other dimensions really do exist. Worlds like the Kigoku World.
One thing after another! The human world sure has it rough, huh~.
That's right! Not even death will part us, darling~!
I did it for you! And this is what I get!? This!!
Calm down. Look closely. It's fake.
Wahaha! So you was alive after all! I'm so happy! I figured you was a goner for sure!
